findings.disposition: Corrected test construction: clipboard command/expected marker pass as structured CDP function arguments; static predicates inspect stored data. No source suppression. Selected actual Mac PTY+Chrome journey passed with simulated Tailscale/phone; Windows CI pending.

Existing file(id) permits only36 hex/hyphen characters, so HTTP values cannot inject path separators or dot traversal. Strengthened stored-record consistency: pending/poll require record.id===requested id before issuing access, and subsequent atomic writes use the validated server-issued stored record ID, after claimant-secret and Tailscale identity validation. Corrupt-record regression RED on prior source and GREEN after correction; original receipt and another device receipt stay intact. Await new CodeQL analysis rather than dismissing path alerts.

Reviewed intentional JSON-state persistence, not arbitrary upload or an executable download. HTTP values are JSON data written to an exclusively opened file descriptor; destinations are server-selected state files. No HTTP parameter chooses atomicJson destination. Shortcuts persist bounded commands intentionally and execute only through a separate authorized action; neither JSON persistence nor parsing executes strings. A distinct paired-owner authorization gap found during this review was corrected and tested, not dismissed.
sourceGroups: Device request names: trimmed, max80, no controls; owner-identity check; generated request ID in fixed device-requests folder.
Paired client names: bounded80; pairing/issuance authorization; fixed private pairing receipt.
Paused, FaceID and screen values: booleans with applicable settings authorization; fixed settings file.

Custom shortcuts: max2000 command or validated app/website record; fixed shortcuts.json; explicit paired device plus admin/apps gate rechecked for save/list/delete/run. Full guests remain excluded even when they hold admin/apps scopes.
findings.limitations: This finding disposition covers these six retained SARIF sources only. It is not a blanket declassification of arbitrary network data, state paths or commands.
